Package org.saidone.protoalf.client

Class Properties

java.lang.Object
org.saidone.protoalf.client.Properties
public final class Properties extends Object
Typed property factories shared by all write clients. Singular factories create scalars; plural factories create explicit lists, including singleton and empty lists. Use nullValue() to clear a scalar and an empty plural factory to clear a list. Omit a property to preserve it on update.

The repository validates value kinds and cardinality against its dictionary; scalars and lists are never implicitly interchanged. These factories do not depend on Alfresco repository classes.
